NHL Hockey - Utah Mammoth at New York Rangers

The Mammoth open their regular-season series against the Rangers at Madison Square Garden. The Mammoth have historically dominated this matchup, winning the last three games. The Rangers seek to bounce back from a 3-0 loss to the Bruins.
NHL Hockey - Calgary Flames at Seattle Kraken

The Seattle Kraken host the Calgary Flames at Climate Pledge Arena. The Kraken enter following a 4-1 win over the Flames in their April meeting led by Jordan Eberle's 55-point season, while Calgary counters behind Matt Coronato's 45 points.
NHL Hockey - Vegas Golden Knights at Vancouver Canucks

The Vancouver Canucks face the Vegas Golden Knights to open their regular-season series at Rogers Arena. Center Jack Eichel leads the Golden Knights in points, goals and assists, while left winger Paul Cotter leads the Canucks in points and goals.
